The results follow from the fact that all the relevant properties are expressible in MSO. Normalizability and solvability for the λY -calculus were already known to be decidable [19]. To the best of our knowledge, the other consequences are new. In future work, we would like to understand the exact complexity of these problems and see whether our results yield optimal bounds.
